_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written from scratch.
name: Navidrome
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Navidrome is a music streaming server for your own collection, with a web player and support for Subsonic apps. The egg installs it with ffmpeg for transcoding and creates the admin account with a password made at install.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Navidrome: downloads Navidrome from its GitHub releases and a static
# ffmpeg (for transcoding) from BtbN's FFmpeg builds, each checked against
# its published checksum. The database and settings in data/ and the music
# folder are never touched; binaries are only replaced once the new ones
# have downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=navidrome/navidrome
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# gh_tag <latest|tag> prints the release's tag; returns 1 when there's no
# such release, 2 when GitHub can't be reached.
gh_tag() {
    local out
    out=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$1" 2>&1) && { echo "$out"; return 0; }
    case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
}
offline="GitHub can't be reached right now, or is limiting downloads. Reinstall to try again in a few minutes."
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ffarch=linux64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ffarch=linuxarm64 ;;
    *) fail "Navidrome has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
case "$version" in latest|v*) ;; *) version="v$version" ;; esac
rc=0; tag=$(gh_tag "$version") || rc=$?
if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    latest=$(gh_tag latest) || fail "$offline"
    fail "Navidrome has no version ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as ${latest#v}."
fi
[ "$rc" = 0 ] || fail "$offline"
version=$tag
asset="navidrome_${version#v}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz"
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$version") || fail "$offline"
sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }' <<<"$assets")
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Navidrome $version has no Linux build for this CPU. Choose another version."

tmp=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$tmp" && mkdir -p "$tmp"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
if [ -x navidrome ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-navidrome 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Navidrome $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Navidrome $version"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$version" "$asset" "$tmp/navidrome.tar.gz" || fail "The download failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$tmp/navidrome.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" navidrome
    mv -f "$tmp/navidrome" navidrome
    echo "$sum" > .raptor-navidrome
fi

# ffmpeg: the newest release build (not the development one) for this CPU.
ff=https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest
sums=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$ff/checksums.sha256") || fail "The ffmpeg builds can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
line=$(grep -E "  ffmpeg-n[0-9.]+-latest-$ffarch-gpl-[0-9.]+\.tar\.xz$" <<<"$sums" | sort -V -k2 | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$line" ] || fail "There's no ffmpeg build for this CPU right now. Reinstall to try again later."
ffsum=${line%% *}
ffname=${line##* }
if [ -x ffmpeg ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-ffmpeg 2>/dev/null)" = "$ffsum" ]; then
    echo "ffmpeg is up to date."
else
    echo "Downloading ${ffname%.tar.xz}"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" "$ff/$ffname"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$ffsum" ] || fail "The ffmpeg download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xJf "$tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz" -C "$tmp" --wildcards --strip-components=2 '*/bin/ffmpeg'
    mv -f "$tmp/ffmpeg" ffmpeg
    echo "$ffsum" > .raptor-ffmpeg
fi
mkdir -p data music

# A new Navidrome lets whoever opens it first create the admin account.
# On the first install, start it once here to create the admin with a
# random password instead.
if [ ! -f data/navidrome.db ]; then
    password=$(head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '/+=')
    ND_DEVAUTOCREATEADMINPASSWORD="$password" ND_ENABLEINSIGHTSCOLLECTOR=false ND_SCANNER_ENABLED=false \
        ./navidrome --address 127.0.0.1 --port 14533 --datafolder data --musicfolder music > "$tmp/first.log" 2>&1 &
    pid=$!
    for _ in $(seq 60); do
        grep -q "Navidrome server is ready" "$tmp/first.log" && break
        kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 1
    done
    kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" || true
    grep -q "Creating initial admin user" "$tmp/first.log" || { sed "s/$password/<password>/g" "$tmp/first.log"; rm -f data/navidrome.db*; fail "Navidrome didn't start to create its admin account. Reinstall to try again."; }
    echo "The admin account is admin, with the password $password. Change it in Navidrome's settings."
fi
echo "Installed Navidrome $version with ${ffname%-latest-*}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Navidrome version to install, such as 0.64.2, or latest.

variables.name: Music folder
variables.description: The folder, in the server's files, that Navidrome reads your music from.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous usage statistics to Navidrome's developers once a day (true or false).
